for f in files:
    # Extract the base name after the last slash
    base = f.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    parts = base.split('__')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date_part, rest = parts
        # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
        if '.' in rest:
            file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
            print(f"date={date_part}, file_name={file_name}, ext={ext}")
        else:
            print(f"no extension: {base}")
    else:
        print(f"unexpected format: {base}")
